paragraph: In January 2026 [the planning minister named the ENDE 2015-2025 as the national statistics strategy](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/ministro-realca-compromisso-com-producao-de-estatistica-robusta-e-credivel/>). Its period ended with 2025. In the last twelve months, [the statistics institute, INE, opened a public consultation on 29 September 2026 on a new strategy](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/ine-inicia-recolha-de-contribuicoes-para-nova-lei-estatistica/>). The consultation ran to 2 October. No review of progress on the ENDE 2015-2025 has been found since 2023, and no evaluation of it. Establishing would need an adopted strategy whose stated period covers today.

The statistics institute, INSBU, [refers to the SNDS-III as the statistics strategy in force](<https://www.insbu.bi/actualitesEtEvenements>). [PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists it as adopted for 2022-2026](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the statutory Groupe Sectoriel Statistique met on 28 July 2026](<https://www.insbu.bi/actualitesEtEvenements>) and discussed the recommendations of the SNDS-III mid-term evaluation. That shows the evaluation had reported. No completion date has been found for it, so the meeting date stands for it.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no national statistics strategy, current or in preparation, has been found for Benin. No source dated in the last three years says the country has none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying the country has no current statistics strategy and none in preparation.

[PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists the Schéma directeur de la statistique 2026-2030 as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the national statistics council examined the draft on 1 December 2025](<https://yop.l-frii.com/burkina-faso-statistique-nationale-examen-dun-projet-estime-a-96689-milliards-de-f-cfa/>), costed at FCFA 96.689 billion. [On 11 September 2026 the head of INSD, the statistics institute, called it the new framework for statistical work](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article149178>). No review of its progress has been found, and no evaluation of it or of the SDS 2021-2025. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[Statistics Botswana and the University of Botswana launched the second Botswana Strategy for Development of Statistics, BSDS 2026-2030](<https://www.ub.bw/news/ub-joins-statistics-botswana-launch-second-bsds-2026-2030-strategy>), a five-year national roadmap. [PARIS21 states it was validated, endorsed and launched in October 2025](<https://www.paris21.org/news/botswana-launches-its-second-nsds>). [The first strategy, BSDS I, covered 2015-2020 and was extended to March 2023](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/documents/Statistics%20Botswana%20Annual%20Report%202023-24.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress and no evaluation have been found since October 2023. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[ICASEES, the statistics institute, says SNDS2 for 2024-2028 was adopted in August 2023](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/428-icasees-evaluation-a-mi-parcours-de-la-deuxieme-strategie-nationale-de-developpement-de-la-statistique>). The last review found earlier was [a workshop on 18 July 2024 to update it](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2024/07/22/centrafrique-mise-a-jour-de-la-strategie-nationale-du-developpement-de-statistique-deuxieme-generation/>). In the last twelve months, [ICASEES reviewed SNDS2's implementation at mid-term on 7-9 October 2026 with the statistical programming committee](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/428-icasees-evaluation-a-mi-parcours-de-la-deuxieme-strategie-nationale-de-developpement-de-la-statistique>), funded by UNDP. No completed evaluation of SNDS2 has been found. Mature would need a mid-term or final evaluation of the current strategy, completed in the past three years.

[On 23 September 2025 the Vision et stratégies report of the SNDS 2026-2030 was adopted](<https://news.abidjan.net/articles/744751/strategie-nationale-de-developpement-de-la-statistique-2026-2030-le-rapport-vision-et-strategies-adopte>). [A workshop validated its action plan on 10 October 2025](<https://www.abidjaneconomie.net/2025/10/11/atelier-de-validation-du-rapport-de-la-snds-2026-2030-une-etape-cle-pour-moderniser-le-systeme-statistique-national/>). In the last twelve months, [technical validation began on 30 April 2026, the last step before adoption](<https://plan.gouv.ci/actualite/960>). [On 8 June 2026 the planning minister presented the strategy as one of the pillars of the statistical system](<https://plan.gouv.ci/index.php/actualite/983>). No review of its progress has been found, and no evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[The statistics institute says Cameroon adopted its third statistics strategy, SNDS30 for 2021-2030, in 2021](<https://ins-cameroun.cm/en/the-financing-of-the-snds30-in-question-in-yaounde/>). [In June 2024 its financing plan set a budget of FCFA 166.5 billion for 2024-2028](<https://ecomatin.net/cameroun-le-gouvernement-veut-mobiliser-166-milliards-de-fcfa-sur-05-ans-pour-developper-son-activite-statistique>). [The institute said in June 2023 that the strategy was evaluated in 2022](<https://ins-cameroun.cm/en/2024-2026-statistical-program-the-snis-validates/>). In the last twelve months, [the steering committee of a regional statistics project met in February 2026 to support its implementation](<https://www.cameroon-tribune.cm/article.html/75463/en.html/statistiques-le-cameroun-mise-sur-la-qualite>). No review of progress on SNDS30 has been found since November 2023. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the SNDS 2022-2026 as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). [The five-year strategy, dated January 2023, carries an action plan of 26,129.4 million FCFA](<https://www.afristat.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/SNDS_2022-2026_Congo.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No annual review, progress report or steering body meeting has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[PARIS21's September 2024 table still listed the NSDS 2015-2019 as in implementation](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2025-03/nsds-summary-table-2024.pdf>), though that period ended in 2019. In the last twelve months, [PARIS21's January 2026 status table listed the SNDS 2026-2030 as being designed or awaiting adoption](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No adoption has been found. No review of progress on a strategy has been found since 2023, and no evaluation of the NSDS 2015-2019. Establishing would need an adopted strategy whose stated period covers today.

[PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the SNDS 2022-2026 as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). [The fourth ENDE, for 2022-2026, was finalised in 2022 after a five-phase process ending in validation](<https://www.afristat.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/ENDE-2022_2026-VF.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [a Budget Support Group mission on 20-28 November 2025 noted progress in implementing the strategy](<https://www.governo.cv/comunicado-de-imprensa-do-grupo-de-apoio-orcamental-20-28-de-novembro-de-2025/>). No annual review, progress report or steering body meeting has been found. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[INSTAD, the statistics institute, and its partners validated SNDS 3 for 2025-2029 at a workshop on 29 April 2025](<https://www.lanation.dj/instad-validation-de-la-troisieme-strategie-nationale-de-developpement-de-la-statistique-2025-2029-snds-3/>). [PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists it as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the World Bank's October 2026 project report said its project supported the strategy's publication](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099101426132022240/pdf/P171777-4c140761-b8a7-4372-9100-f528fd060b61.pdf>). No adoption date has been found. No review of progress on SNDS 3 has been found, and no evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[The ONS Director General recalled the national statistics strategy 2024-2028 on 19 November 2024](<http://news.radioalgerie.dz/fr/node/55477>) at a Finance Ministry information day. [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2015-2025 as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress on the strategy has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[In June 2024 the planning ministry said a national strategy for the statistical system had been in preparation for nearly two years](<https://mped.gov.eg/singlenews?id=5528&lang=en>). Eighteen ministries and government and research bodies took part, and a first draft was expected the next month. [PARIS21's September 2024 table lists the NSDS 2017-2021 as expired and the next one as being finalised](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2025-03/nsds-summary-table-2024.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since 2023, and no evaluation of the NSDS 2017-2021. Establishing would need an adopted strategy whose stated period covers today.

[PARIS21's September 2024 table had listed only the Statistical Master Plan for 2010-14, as expired](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2025-03/nsds-summary-table-2024.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [PARIS21's January 2026 status table listed the Statistical Master Plan 2023-2026 as the strategy being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). [In July 2026 UNICEF named an updated Statistical Master Plan among efforts to close gaps in data on children](<https://www.unicef.org/executiveboard/media/40026/file/2026-PL15-Eritrea-CPD-EN-ODS.pdf>). The 2023-2026 plan's period ends in 2026. No review of its progress has been found, and no evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[On 1 February 2024 the planning ministry unveiled the Ethiopian Statistics Development Program, to run for three years](<https://www.fanamc.com/english/population-housing-census-to-be-conducted-in-forthcoming-triennium-ministry/>). [PARIS21's September 2024 table gives its period as 2023/24-2025/26](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2025-03/nsds-summary-table-2024.pdf>) and lists the next strategy as being designed, with funding secured. [PARIS21's January 2026 table lists an NSDS 2021-2026 as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since 2023. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists the SNDS 2023-2025 as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). Its period ended in 2025. In the last twelve months, [INSTAT Gabon said in October 2026 that it had begun drafting SNDS-III for 2027-2030](<https://new.instatgabon.org/fr/actualite/snds-2027-2030-l-instat-gabon-renforce-les-capacites-des-acteurs-du-systeme-statistique-national>). [An international expert's second mission on its strategic orientations was set for 1 to 13 November 2026](<https://new.instatgabon.org/fr/actualite/snds-2026-2030-deuxieme-mission-de-l-expert-international-alain-brilleau-a-l-instat-gabon>). No adopted strategy whose period is still running has been found. Establishing would need an adopted strategy whose stated period covers today.

[On 18 March 2026 the Ghana Statistical Service held a workshop to validate NSDS III for 2026-2030](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/alhassan-iddrisu-464638394_nsdsiii-ghanadata-evidencebasedgovernance-activity-7440052863508201473-XCxg>). [PARIS21's January 2026 status table listed a successor to NSDS 2018-2022 as being designed or awaiting adoption](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, [the Data Forum called NSDS III finalised and asked the Service to secure its adoption by Cabinet](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/business/business-news/data-forum-urges-government-to-expedite-statistics-bill-and-national-statistics-fund.html>). No source found shows NSDS III adopted. Establishing would need an adopted strategy whose stated period covers today.

No stage is set. Guinea's third statistics strategy, the SNDS 2021-2025, ended in 2025. As at 13 November 2026, no successor in preparation or adopted has been found, and no adoption date for the SNDS 2021-2025. No source dated in the last three years says the country has no strategy. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a national statistics strategy being designed, drafted, validated or put to cabinet.

[PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the NSDS 2024-2028 as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). [STATAFRIC says The Gambia has adopted NSDS III 2024-2028](<https://statafric.au.int/en/news/press-releases/2025-11-17/peer-review-report-national-statistical-system-gambia>). [The national statistical system technically approved it on 13 September 2023](<https://www.gbosdata.org/downloads-file/526-national-strategy-for-the-development-of-stati>), and it went to the National Statistics Council and Cabinet. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress on NSDS III has been found since October 2023. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[In 2023 the statistics institute posted a draft strategic plan for the national statistical system over 2023-2028](<https://www.stat-guinebissau.com/Menu_principal/Pubica%C3%A7%C3%B5es/IHPC/2023/Plano%20estrategico%202023-2028.pdf>), with a mission, values and three objectives, and no costing. [PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists ENDE 2021-2024 as the strategy being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>), though its period ended in 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows the draft plan adopted. No review of progress has been found since November 2023. Establishing would need an adopted strategy whose stated period covers today.

[INEGE, the statistics institute, prepared the ENDE 2022-2026](<https://inege.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/ENDE-2022-2026-1.pdf>). [In March 2024 the press office reported that Decree 103 approves the strategy](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/inege_realiza_una_gira_sobre_la_estrategia_de_desarrollo_estadistico_2022-2026>). In February 2025 [the Statistical Programmes Committee adopted the 2024 implementation report](<https://inege.org/?p=6815>). In the last twelve months, [the committee took the 2025 implementation report in April 2026](<https://inege.org/?p=16157>). [In August 2026 the national statistics council had that report on its agenda for validation](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/el_consejo_nacional_de_estadistica_analiza_los_avances_de_las_principales_operaciones_estadisticas_del_pais>). No evaluation of the ENDE 2022-2026 has been found. Mature would need a mid-term or final evaluation of the current strategy, completed in the past three years.

[KNBS publishes the second Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics, KSDS II, for 2023/24-2027/28](<https://www.knbs.or.ke/the-second-kenya-strategy-for-development-of-statistics/>) as the national statistical system strategy. [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists it as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No annual review, progress report or steering body meeting has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[NSDS III for 2026-2030 was signed at Monrovia on 15 December 2025](<https://lisgis.gov.lr/uploads/nsds/nsdsIII.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [LISGIS, the statistics institute, launched the strategy officially on 18 February 2026](<https://frontpageafricaonline.com/liberia-lisgis-launches-national-statistics-strategy-set-to-unveils-new-population-policy/>). [PARIS21's January 2026 status table still listed it as being designed or awaiting adoption](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). [The first strategy, NSDS I, ran from 2008 to 2013](<https://lisgis.gov.lr/uploads/nsds/nsdsIII.pdf>). No review of progress on NSDS III has been found, and no evaluation of NSDS III or NSDS I. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no national statistics strategy, current or in preparation, has been found for Libya. No source dated in the last three years says the country has none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying the country has no current statistics strategy and none in preparation.

[The Bureau of Statistics lists NSDS II for 2022/23-2026/27 among its current strategic documents](<http://www.bos.gov.ls/about_bos.htm>). [PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists NSDS 2022-2027 as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). [A STATAFRIC peer review in August 2025 found over 80% of the strategy's budget allocated to the Bureau](<https://statafric.au.int/sites/default/files/2025-12/ef_peerreview_lesotho_vf.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress on NSDS II has been found since November 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[In March 2024 INSTAT presented the second strategy, SNDS 2023-2030, as the government's reference framework](<https://www.instat.mg/p/strategie-nationale-de-developpement-de-la-statistique-snds-deuxieme-generation-2023>). [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists it as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years, such as an annual review or a steering body meeting.

[On 19 November 2024 the national statistics council launched the drafting of the fourth Schéma Directeur de la Statistique](<https://www.instat-mali.org/fr/actualites-et-evenements/quatrieme-generation-du-schema-directeur-de-la-statistique-du-mali>). [On 6-7 February 2025 two commissions validated the final evaluation report of the SDS 2020-2024](<https://www.instat-mali.org/fr/actualites-et-evenements/atelier-de-validation-du-rapport-devaluation-du-3eme-schema-directeur-de-la-statistique-sds-2020-2024>). In the last twelve months, [INSTAT held the 17th technical session of the annual review in Bamako on 13-14 August 2026](<https://instat-mali.org/fr/actualites-et-evenements/dix-septieme-session-technique-de-la-revue-annuelle-du-schema-directeur-de-la-statistique>). [On 9 October 2026 the Council of Ministers took note of SDS IV and its 2026-2030 action plan](<https://icimali.com/mali-communique-du-conseil-des-ministres-du-vendredi-9-octobre-2026-cm-n2026-40-sgg46239-2/>). No source found records a formal adoption of that action plan.

[PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the NSDS 2025-2029 as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). It is the only fact found on the country's statistics strategy. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No annual review, progress report or steering body meeting has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[In 2021 Mauritania set out a ten-year national statistical development strategy, SNDDS 2021-2030, with an action plan for 2021-2025](<https://afristat.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/17_SNDDS-2021-2030-plan-dactions-2021-2025.pdf>). [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists it as implementing (adopted), as SNDDS 2021-2023](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). The new strategy also set out an evaluation of the previous one, SNDS 2016-2020. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since October 2023. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no national statistics strategy, current or in preparation, has been found for Mauritius. No source dated in the last three years says the country has none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying the country has no current statistics strategy and none in preparation.

[The Nation reports that Malawi's National Statistical Office has finalised the National Statistical System Strategic Plan (NSS SP IV) 2025-2030](<https://mwnation.com/nso-renews-strategic-plan/>), covering 35 ministries, departments and agencies. [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists it as implementing (adopted), for 2026-2030](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[In February 2023 the Namibia Statistics Agency published the NSDS 2023/24-2026/27](<https://nsa.org.na/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/NSDS-Report.pdf>), costed at N$58,995,000 across ten sector statistics plans. [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists it as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[The government adopted SNDS III for 2022-2026 in 2022, the statistics institute says](<https://stat-niger.org/wp-content/uploads/rapport_enquete/Rapport_sur_etat_de_la_statistique_du_SSN_2024.pdf>). [Its May 2022 text costs the action plan at FCFA 85.89 billion](<https://www.afristat.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/SNDS-III_Niger.pdf>), of which 35.5% was secured at adoption. In the last twelve months, the institute reported in December 2025 that coordination work in 2024 carried out the action plan. [PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists the strategy as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No review of progress has been found since November 2023. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[Its text, dated June 2024, puts the five-year cost of NSDS III for 2024-2028 at US$875 million](<https://microdata.nigerianstat.gov.ng/index.php/catalog/174/download/1324/NSDS_III_2025_REPORT.pdf>), with 51% from governments. In the last twelve months, [the government unveiled NSDS III on 15 December 2025](<https://nannews.ng/2025/12/15/fg-unveils-strategic-data-initiatives-for-evidence-based-governance-inclusive-development/>), and [the Statistician-General said in his 2026 message that the Bureau would implement its reforms that year](<https://nigerianstat.gov.ng/page/sg-message>). [PARIS21's January 2026 status table lists it as being implemented](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No review of progress on NSDS III has been found since its launch. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

[Rwanda's fourth National Strategy for the Development of Statistics, NSDS4, covers July 2024 to June 2029](<https://statistics.gov.rw/sites/default/files/documents/2025-05/NSDS4%20%282024_2029%29.pdf>). NISR produced it, and the Minister of Finance and Economic Planning and the NISR Director General introduced it. [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists it as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No review of progress has been found since October 2023, and no mid-term or final evaluation. Operating would need a review of progress on the current strategy in the past three years.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no national statistics strategy, current or in preparation, has been found for Sudan. No source dated in the last three years says the country has none. [PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the SNDS 2025-2029 as implementing (adopted)](<https://www.paris21.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2026-02/nsds_summary_table_2026.pdf>).
